defmodule CloudInfra.Auth.NTLMHandler do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles NTLM authentication for hybrid cloud connections.
  Supports both direct authentication and proxy-mediated flows.
  """

  require Logger

  defstruct [
    :target_host,
    :credentials,
    :session_key,
    :channel_binding,
    :signing_required,
    :relay_protection
  ]

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  @epa_flag 0x00080000
  @sign_flag 0x00000010
  @seal_flag 0x00000020
  @mic_flag 0x00000002

  def new(opts) do
    %__MODULE__{
      target_host: Keyword.fetch!(opts, :target_host),
      credentials: Keyword.fetch!(opts, :credentials),
      session_key: nil,
      channel_binding: resolve_channel_binding(opts),
      signing_required: Keyword.get(opts, :signing_required, true),
      relay_protection: resolve_relay_protection(opts)
    }
  end

  defp resolve_channel_binding(opts) do
    case Keyword.get(opts, :channel_binding) do
      nil -> derive_channel_binding_from_env()
      cb -> cb
    end
  end

  defp derive_channel_binding_from_env do
    case System.get_env("CLOUD_INFRA_TLS_BINDING") do
      nil -> :tls_unique
      "none" -> :tls_server_end_point
      "endpoint" -> :tls_server_end_point
      "unique" -> :tls_unique
      _ -> :tls_unique
    end
  end

  defp resolve_relay_protection(_opts) do
    :strict
  end

  def negotiate_flags(%__MODULE__{} = handler) do
    base_flags = @sign_flag ||| @seal_flag

    flags = case handler.relay_protection do
      :strict -> base_flags ||| @epa_flag ||| @mic_flag
      :permissive -> base_flags
    end

    flags = if handler.signing_required do
      flags ||| @sign_flag
    else
      flags
    end

    {:ok, flags}
  end

  def process_challenge(%__MODULE__{} = handler, challenge_msg) do
    with {:ok, server_flags} <- extract_flags(challenge_msg),
         {:ok, target_info} <- extract_target_info(challenge_msg),
         :ok <- validate_challenge_integrity(handler, server_flags, target_info) do
      build_authenticate_message(handler, challenge_msg, server_flags)
    end
  end

  defp validate_challenge_integrity(handler, server_flags, target_info) do
    cond do
      handler.relay_protection == :strict and not has_flag?(server_flags, @epa_flag) ->
        {:error, :epa_not_supported}

      handler.relay_protection == :strict and not has_mic_av_pair?(target_info) ->
        {:error, :mic_required}

      handler.relay_protection == :permissive ->
        :ok

      true ->
        :ok
    end
  end

  defp build_authenticate_message(handler, challenge_msg, server_flags) do
    session_key = compute_session_key(handler.credentials, challenge_msg)

    auth_msg = %{
      flags: elem(negotiate_flags(handler), 1),
      session_key: session_key,
      target_host: handler.target_host,
      channel_bindings: compute_channel_bindings(handler),
      mic: nil
    }

    auth_msg = if handler.relay_protection == :strict do
      mic = compute_mic(session_key, challenge_msg, auth_msg)
      %{auth_msg | mic: mic}
    else
      auth_msg
    end

    {:ok, auth_msg}
  end

  defp compute_channel_bindings(%__MODULE__{channel_binding: :none}) do
    <<0::128>>
  end

  defp compute_channel_bindings(%__MODULE__{channel_binding: binding_type} = handler) do
    case binding_type do
      :tls_server_end_point ->
        cert_hash = get_server_cert_hash(handler.target_host)
        :crypto.hash(:md5, ["tls-server-end-point", <<0>>, cert_hash])

      :tls_unique ->
        tls_finished = get_tls_finished_message(handler.target_host)
        :crypto.hash(:md5, ["tls-unique", <<0>>, tls_finished])
    end
  end

  defp compute_session_key(credentials, challenge_msg) do
    nt_hash = :crypto.hash(:md4, credentials.password)
    server_challenge = binary_part(challenge_msg, 24, 8)
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, nt_hash, server_challenge)
  end

  defp compute_mic(session_key, challenge_msg, auth_msg) do
    data = :erlang.term_to_binary({challenge_msg, auth_msg})
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, session_key, data)
  end

  defp extract_flags(challenge_msg) when byte_size(challenge_msg) >= 24 do
    <<_header::binary-size(12), _target::binary-size(8), flags::little-32, _rest::binary>> = challenge_msg
    {:ok, flags}
  end
  defp extract_flags(_), do: {:error, :invalid_challenge}

  defp extract_target_info(challenge_msg) when byte_size(challenge_msg) >= 40 do
    <<_pre::binary-size(40), target_info::binary>> = challenge_msg
    {:ok, parse_av_pairs(target_info)}
  end
  defp extract_target_info(_), do: {:ok, []}

  defp parse_av_pairs(<<>>), do: []
  defp parse_av_pairs(<<0::16, 0::16, _::binary>>), do: []
  defp parse_av_pairs(<<id::little-16, len::little-16, value::binary-size(len), rest::binary>>) do
    [{id, value} | parse_av_pairs(rest)]
  end
  defp parse_av_pairs(_), do: []

  defp has_flag?(flags, flag), do: (flags &&& flag) == flag

  defp has_mic_av_pair?(target_info) do
    Enum.any?(target_info, fn {id, _} -> id == 0x0006 end)
  end

  defp get_server_cert_hash(_host), do: :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)
  defp get_tls_finished_message(_host), do: :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(12)
end

defmodule CloudInfra.Connection do
  @moduledoc "Manages authenticated connections to cloud infrastructure endpoints."

  alias CloudInfra.Auth.NTLMHandler

  def connect(target, credentials, opts \\ []) do
    handler = NTLMHandler.new([
      target_host: target,
      credentials: credentials
    ] ++ opts)

    with {:ok, negotiate_flags} <- NTLMHandler.negotiate_flags(handler),
         {:ok, challenge} <- send_negotiate(target, negotiate_flags),
         {:ok, auth_msg} <- NTLMHandler.process_challenge(handler, challenge),
         {:ok, session} <- send_authenticate(target, auth_msg) do
      {:ok, session}
    end
  end

  defp send_negotiate(_target, _flags), do: {:ok, :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(64)}
  defp send_authenticate(_target, _auth_msg), do: {:ok, %{status: :authenticated}}
end
